title: Groupe BPCE
description: bpce-vietnam.com zoominfo.com/c/groupe-bpce/457963650 BPCE International (formerly Natixis), the Ho Chi Minh City branch of France’s second-largest banking group, Groupe BPCE. Operating in Vietnam since 1988, it is one of the country's longest-established foreign bank branches, holding a full banking license. The institution specializes in corporate and investment banking, offering specialized finance, trade solutions, and transaction processing to businesses across the region.
